profile_text.body:
Twilio is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, traded under the ticker TWLO, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001447669. Its website describes a platform of APIs for SMS, RCS, voice, and email, combined with conversational AI and identity verification. The company frames the offering as connecting communication channels, customer context, and AI on a single platform, with pay-as-you-go pricing and flexible plans.

Per its own site, Twilio positions AI agents as participants in customer conversations alongside human staff. The company says these agents draw on internal knowledge and real-time data, hand off to people when complexity or customer intent calls for it, and transfer conversations with full context so customers do not repeat themselves. It describes the platform as orchestrating context-rich conversations across channels for both humans and AI agents, and markets this as built for engagement in what it calls the agentic era.

The held facts add little beyond corporate identity. No lawsuits are listed, and no products or MCP servers are tracked. The company's recorded litigation exposure sits in California, with a count of 281.
